rationale: WING has gapped up ~7.75% on 5.67x relative volume with no news catalyst identified, suggesting a possible earnings or corporate event, but the stock is already at 90% of its intraday range near the session high ($141.75) with the last few candles showing distribution (high of $141.75 not being reclaimed, price fading). The bid-ask spread of 71 bps on a $140 stock creates meaningful friction, and entering long near the high of a large gap-up move without a clear catalyst or pullback setup carries poor risk/reward; a short against the high is equally risky given the strong momentum and unknown catalyst. Skipping preserves capital while the picture clarifies.
